question: Q-f2-delta-w-credit-predictive-power
conjecture: In the typed lesson store (weights = external typed records), credit estimated by budget-capped TMC-Shapley (phi_i per lesson) predicts measured causal contribution: credit-informed edits beat same-size random edits on fresh heldout accuracy, and estimated phi ranks agree with measured LOO delta-V (Spearman rho >= 0.2). deltaW itself is fully observed (version hash + typed edit log); the unproven part is credit predictive power.

arms.a_credit_informed: TMC-Shapley phi_i per lesson, edits only on top-credit / bottom anti-credit lessons
arms.b_random_edit: same-size random edits (identical insert/delete/reweight counts, random targets)
arms.c_verbal_gradient: TextGrad-style LLM critic proposed edits (heuristic attribution control)

secondary_discriminators.credit_validation_gate: Spearman rho(phi_i, measured LOO delta-V) >= 0.2 required to keep the arm; rho < 0.2 -> estimator arm discarded before main run
secondary_discriminators.planted_ground_truth_testbed: signal->content 2-gate + SHA-deranged placebo store (same schema/tokens, unrelated content)

already_public_before_registration.note: 16 findings are literature/design knowledge only; no arm output was measured or inspected. Existing gate receipts (p1v3/p1v4/F1/C1) are cited as public receipts only.
already_public_before_registration.harness_provenance: p1v4 actuation harness reused; null battery harness pending (plan-hswm4-null-battery-harness-20260725)

kill_conditions: f2_k1 credit_informed - random_edit <= 0 -> claim 1 (result->credit->deltaW) remains UNPROVEN
f2_k2 improvement with deltaW = 0 (placebo store >= credit arm, form==content effect) -> immediate kill
f2_k3 saturation (no-memory arm >= 5/6) -> re-register with harder split (p1v2 lesson)
